title: 3877. Minimum Removals to Achieve Target XOR

examples.explanation: Removing nums[1] = 2 leaves [nums[0], nums[2]] = [1, 3]. The XOR of [1, 3] is 2, which equals target. It is not possible to achieve XOR = 2 in less than one removal, therefore the answer is 1.
It is impossible to remove elements to achieve target. Thus, the answer is -1.
The XOR of all elements is nums[0] = 7, which equals target. Thus, no removal is needed.
